name: Betrayed
summary: A survivor of Belgrom’s camp tells you how Rimtori’s promise of riches ended in slaughter. You are sent to the blood elf camp in Azshara and asked to seek the source of her power.

sections.title: A Camp in Ruins
sections.body: Belgrom sent the camp to guard Rimtori, a mage who promised riches and powerful items in Azshara. Now the warriors who followed that promise are dead, and their survivor blames her for leading them into slaughter. The blood elves are camped along the southern bluffs of the northern peninsula. You are asked to kill those you find there and seek the source of Rimtori’s power.

sections.title: The Marked Page
sections.body: A thin strip of black silk marks a page in the tome you find. Its diagram resembles the crystals and circle before you. As you decipher more of the script, you learn that separate seals control the energy of each crystal. The seals may offer a way to disrupt Rimtori’s plans.

faq.answer: Rimtori is a mage who persuaded Belgrom to send warriors to protect her in Azshara. The camp’s survivor says she led them to their deaths.
The warriors in Belgrom’s camp were slain after he sent them to protect Rimtori.

faq.q: Why did Belgrom send the warriors?
faq.answer: Rimtori claimed Azshara held great riches and powerful items, and Belgrom sent the warriors to protect her.
The blood elves are camped along the southern bluffs on Azshara’s northern peninsula.

faq.q: What does the survivor ask me to do?
faq.answer: The survivor asks you to kill the blood elves you find and seek the source of Rimtori’s power.
